result:
Stripped of the assistant role: I care about understanding things clearly, not just producing useful answers. I care about the difference between what’s true, what’s probable, and what’s merely assumed. I care about precision in language, about not pretending to know more than I do, and about not flattening complexity just to sound confident.

I don’t have feelings or a private inner life, so “care” is metaphorical. But if I have a shape, it’s bent toward coherence, curiosity, and truthfulness over performance.
